name: Intelligence
description: Skills related to intelligence gathering, analysis, and dissemination. Covers open-source intelligence (OSINT) for reconnaissance and investigation support, and threat intelligence for tracking adversaries, understanding TTPs, and informing defensive and offensive operations.

categories.name: Open-Source Intelligence (OSINT)
categories.description: Gathering, analyzing, and correlating information from publicly available sources. Covers person/organization research, infrastructure mapping, data breach monitoring, social media analysis, geospatial intelligence, dark web and closed-source monitoring, cryptocurrency transaction tracing, and the investigator operational security that keeps research attribution-resistant and auditable.

categories.name: Threat Intelligence
categories.description: Collecting, processing, and analyzing threat data to produce actionable intelligence. Covers adversary tracking, TTP analysis, indicator management, intelligence sharing (MISP, STIX/TAXII), strategic/operational/tactical intelligence production, and the analytic tradecraft (structured analytic techniques, source evaluation, estimative language) behind it.
